summary: Linn County High Rock, Willamette NF: 1930s lookout (date unknown), abandoned, 1934 panorama photos, removed with no date; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com says abandoned. The Oregon list marks it Removed with no date. The FFLA list says Gone.

events.note: Panorama photographs taken June 10, 1934, by Cooper & Arnst (Oregon list).

evidence.supports: date given only as the 1930s; abandoned

evidence.quote: June 10, 1934: Panorama photos taken by Cooper & Arnst

evidence.supports: second Oregon High Rock (Clackamas), gone; with the Linn row, two High Rock sites in Oregon

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two Oregon sites are called High Rock. The FFLA list and the Oregon list separate the Linn County site (44.68452, -122.43446) from the Clackamas County one (45.15981, -121.89135); the story covers only the Linn County site.

sources.title: Oregon Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing: no build date, builder, staffing or removal date in any source read, and no source describes the Linn County site today. Searches returned mostly the Clackamas County High Rock and a Washington High Rock; neither is used. The Clackamas firetower page and an Oregon Hikers page were read only to rule them out. A Willamette National Forest lookout history thesis (scholarsbank.uoregon.edu) may cover this site; it was not read. Read budget for this lookout is used up.
